articles_published_state_check.name: articles_published_state_check
articles_published_state_check.value: "articles"."status" <> 'published' or ("articles"."published_revision_id" is not null and "articles"."published_at" is not null)

cms_membership_invitations_email_check.name: cms_membership_invitations_email_check
cms_membership_invitations_email_check.value:
"cms_membership_invitations"."email" = lower(btrim("cms_membership_invitations"."email"))
        and "cms_membership_invitations"."email" ~ '^[a-z0-9.!#$%&''*+/=?^_{|}~-]+@unijorge[.]com([.]br)?$'
        and split_part("cms_membership_invitations"."email", '@', 1) not like '.%'
        and split_part("cms_membership_invitations"."email", '@', 1) not like '%.'
        and split_part("cms_membership_invitations"."email", '@', 1) not like '%..%'

cms_membership_invitations_state_check.name: cms_membership_invitations_state_check
cms_membership_invitations_state_check.value:
("cms_membership_invitations"."status" = 'pending' and "cms_membership_invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "cms_membership_invitations"."revoked_at" is null and "cms_membership_invitations"."accepted_membership_id" is null)
        or ("cms_membership_invitations"."status" = 'accepted' and "cms_membership_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "cms_membership_invitations"."revoked_at" is null and "cms_membership_invitations"."accepted_membership_id" is not null)
        or ("cms_membership_invitations"."status" = 'revoked' and "cms_membership_invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "cms_membership_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null and "cms_membership_invitations"."accepted_membership_id" is null)

media_assets_dimensions_check.name: media_assets_dimensions_check
media_assets_dimensions_check.value: ("media_assets"."width" is null or "media_assets"."width" > 0) and ("media_assets"."height" is null or "media_assets"."height" > 0)

media_assets_kind_metadata_check.name: media_assets_kind_metadata_check
media_assets_kind_metadata_check.value:
("media_assets"."media_kind" = 'image' and "media_assets"."duration_ms" is null and "media_assets"."video_codec" is null and "media_assets"."has_audio" is null and "media_assets"."object_etag" is null)
        or ("media_assets"."media_kind" = 'video' and "media_assets"."checksum_sha256" is null)
        or ("media_assets"."media_kind" = 'captions' and "media_assets"."width" is null and "media_assets"."height" is null and "media_assets"."video_codec" is null and "media_assets"."has_audio" is null and "media_assets"."object_etag" is null)

media_assets_ready_metadata_check.name: media_assets_ready_metadata_check
media_assets_ready_metadata_check.value:
"media_assets"."status" <> 'ready' or (
        ("media_assets"."media_kind" = 'image' and "media_assets"."public_object_key" is not null and "media_assets"."checksum_sha256" is not null and "media_assets"."width" is not null and "media_assets"."height" is not null)
        or ("media_assets"."media_kind" = 'video' and "media_assets"."mime_type" = 'video/mp4' and "media_assets"."public_object_key" is not null and "media_assets"."object_etag" is not null and "media_assets"."width" is not null and "media_assets"."height" is not null and "media_assets"."duration_ms" is not null and "media_assets"."video_codec" is not null and "media_assets"."has_audio" is not null)
        or ("media_assets"."media_kind" = 'captions' and "media_assets"."mime_type" = 'text/vtt' and "media_assets"."public_object_key" is not null and "media_assets"."checksum_sha256" is not null and "media_assets"."duration_ms" is not null)
      )
